ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% low-intensity (black) to 25% high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity contiguous white patch on the far left tip extending medially; smaller high-intensity patch on the far right tip; scattered white linear streaks and mottling on the medial-left lobe; central region is primarily solid low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped central depression with an estimated angle of 130 degrees and a depth approximately 8% of the total vertical span of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular micro-serrations with low pixel-amplitude (less than 1% of fluke width) along the entire trailing edge; frequency of irregularities increases on the distal third of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the trailing edges of both lobes, with a slight sigmoidal recurve approaching the medial notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular, high-contrast white pixel groups localized on the extreme outer tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake-like scratches) crossing the dark pigment on the left lobe at oblique angles.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy textural irregularity and high-contrast white encrustations on both lobe terminals; prominent linear scratch marks on the left ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The left fluke tip displays a significantly more jagged and eroded geometric profile compared to the relatively smoother right tip.
